# University of Toronto
> A globally top-ranked public research university offering undergraduate, graduate, professional, and continuing education across three campuses.

The University of Toronto’s web presence spans central university information, admissions, academics, research, libraries, student services, campus life, and faculty- and division-level resources. This index prioritizes authoritative university pages, service portals, and major academic and research resources.

## University Overview
- [University of Toronto Home](https://www.utoronto.ca): Central gateway for university news, academics, research, and institutional information.
- [About U of T](https://www.utoronto.ca/about-u-of-t): Overview of the university’s history, mission, leadership, and global reputation.
- [Campuses](https://www.utoronto.ca/campuses): Introduction to the St. George, Mississauga, and Scarborough campuses.
- [Leadership](https://www.utoronto.ca/leadership): Profiles and information about the university’s senior leadership and governance.
- [News](https://www.utoronto.ca/news): Official university news, research stories, announcements, and expert commentary.
- [Events](https://www.utoronto.ca/events): University-wide calendar of lectures, conferences, performances, and community events.

## Admissions & Future Students
- [Admissions](https://www.utoronto.ca/admissions): Central admissions hub for undergraduate and graduate applicants.
- [Future Students](https://future.utoronto.ca): Prospective student information on programs, applications, and student life.
- [How to Apply](https://future.utoronto.ca/apply): Step-by-step undergraduate application guidance for future students.
- [Programs of Study](https://future.utoronto.ca/academics/programs-directory): Searchable directory of undergraduate academic programs and areas of study.
- [Tuition Fees & Costs](https://future.utoronto.ca/finances/tuition-fees): Overview of tuition, incidental fees, and expected education costs.
- [Awards & Financial Aid](https://future.utoronto.ca/finances/awards): Scholarships, awards, and financial support for prospective undergraduates.
- [Visit U of T](https://future.utoronto.ca/visit): Campus tours, virtual events, and opportunities to explore the university.

## Academics & Programs
- [Academics](https://www.utoronto.ca/academics): Central academic information covering programs, calendars, and learning resources.
- [Faculties & Divisions](https://www.utoronto.ca/academics/faculties-and-divisions): Directory of U of T faculties, schools, and academic divisions.
- [Academic Calendar](https://www.utoronto.ca/academics/academic-calendar): Official academic calendars and important academic dates.
- [Programs & Courses](https://www.utoronto.ca/academics/programs-directory): Entry point for exploring academic offerings across the university.
- [School of Graduate Studies](https://www.sgs.utoronto.ca): Graduate admissions, programs, policies, and student resources.
- [Continuing Studies](https://learn.utoronto.ca): Continuing education courses, certificates, and professional learning opportunities.

## Research & Innovation
- [Research & Innovation](https://www.utoronto.ca/research-innovation): Overview of research strengths, partnerships, and innovation activity.
- [Research at U of T News](https://www.utoronto.ca/news/research-innovation): Research-focused news and discoveries from across the university.
- [Innovation & Partnerships](https://www.utoronto.ca/research-innovation/innovation-entrepreneurship): Information on entrepreneurship, commercialization, and industry collaboration.
- [Libraries Research Support](https://onesearch.library.utoronto.ca/research-help): Research help, consultations, and scholarly support through U of T Libraries.
- [Ethics Review](https://research.utoronto.ca/ethics-human-research): Human research ethics guidance, policies, and review processes.
- [Research Services Office](https://research.utoronto.ca): Central research administration, funding, and compliance information.

## Libraries & Scholarly Resources
- [University of Toronto Libraries](https://onesearch.library.utoronto.ca): Main library portal for discovery, services, and research support.
- [Omni Search](https://onesearch.library.utoronto.ca/discovery): Search interface for books, articles, journals, and other library materials.
- [Libraries A-Z](https://onesearch.library.utoronto.ca/library-info/library-locations): Directory of library locations, hours, and contact information.
- [Databases A-Z](https://onesearch.library.utoronto.ca/az/databases): Alphabetical listing of research databases available through the libraries.
- [Research Guides](https://guides.library.utoronto.ca): Subject and course guides curated by librarians.
- [TSpace](https://tspace.library.utoronto.ca): Institutional repository for theses, articles, and scholarly outputs.
- [Open Access Support](https://onesearch.library.utoronto.ca/open-access): Guidance on open access publishing and author rights.

## Students & Campus Life
- [Current Students](https://www.utoronto.ca/current-students): Central hub for student services, academics, and campus resources.
- [ACORN](https://acorn.utoronto.ca): Student portal for course enrolment, fees, transcripts, and academic records.
- [Quercus](https://q.utoronto.ca): Learning management system for courses, assignments, and class communication.
- [Student Life](https://studentlife.utoronto.ca): Resources for wellbeing, housing, leadership, and student experience.
- [Housing](https://studentlife.utoronto.ca/task/housing): Housing information, residence options, and off-campus living resources.
- [Health & Wellness](https://studentlife.utoronto.ca/task/health-wellness): Student supports for physical health, mental health, and wellbeing.
- [Career Exploration & Education](https://studentlife.utoronto.ca/service/career-exploration-education): Career advising, workshops, and employment preparation resources.
- [Registrar](https://www.utoronto.ca/academics/registrar): Registrar-related academic and administrative information for students.

## Campus Services & IT
- [UTORid](https://utorid.utoronto.ca): Identity management portal for account activation and password services.
- [UTORMFA](https://mfa.utoronto.ca): Multi-factor authentication service for securing university accounts.
- [Information Commons Help Desk](https://help.ic.utoronto.ca): IT support resources and service information for university users.
- [U of T ServiceNow Portal](https://uthrprod.service-now.com/sp): Service portal for administrative and support requests.
- [UCheck](https://ucheck.utoronto.ca): University health screening and campus access tool.
- [Bookstore](https://uoftbookstore.com): Official bookstore for textbooks, course materials, and merchandise.

## Campuses
- [St. George Campus](https://www.utoronto.ca/campuses/downtown-toronto-st-george): Overview of the downtown Toronto St. George campus.
- [University of Toronto Mississauga](https://www.utm.utoronto.ca): Campus site for UTM academics, admissions, and student life.
- [University of Toronto Scarborough](https://www.utsc.utoronto.ca): Campus site for UTSC programs, services, and community information.
- [Mississauga Future Students](https://www.utm.utoronto.ca/future-students): Admissions and program information for prospective UTM students.
- [Scarborough Admissions](https://www.utsc.utoronto.ca/admissions): Admissions guidance and recruitment information for UTSC applicants.

## Faculties & Professional Schools
- [Faculty of Arts & Science](https://www.artsci.utoronto.ca): Largest academic division with undergraduate programs across disciplines.
- [Faculty of Applied Science & Engineering](https://engineering.utoronto.ca): Engineering programs, research, admissions, and student resources.
- [Temerty Faculty of Medicine](https://temertymedicine.utoronto.ca): Medical education, biomedical research, and faculty information.
- [Faculty of Law](https://www.law.utoronto.ca): Law programs, admissions, clinics, and legal research resources.
- [Rotman School of Management](https://www.rotman.utoronto.ca): Business education, MBA programs, executive education, and research.
- [Dalla Lana School of Public Health](https://www.dlsph.utoronto.ca): Public health education, research, and professional training.
- [Ontario Institute for Studies in Education](https://www.oise.utoronto.ca): Education research, teacher education, and graduate programs.
- [Faculty of Information](https://ischool.utoronto.ca): Information, library, UX, and knowledge management programs.

## Global Engagement & Community
- [International](https://www.utoronto.ca/international): Global partnerships, mobility, and international engagement initiatives.
- [Centre for International Experience](https://internationalexperience.utoronto.ca): Study abroad, exchange, and international learning opportunities.
- [Alumni](https://alumni.utoronto.ca): Alumni benefits, events, networking, and giving opportunities.
- [Boundless Campaign](https://boundless.utoronto.ca): University fundraising campaign supporting research, students, and priorities.
- [Giving to U of T](https://give.utoronto.ca): Donation portal and philanthropic support opportunities.
- [Community Safety](https://www.campussafety.utoronto.ca): Safety resources, emergency information, and campus security contacts.

## Governance, Policies & Careers
- [Governing Council](https://governingcouncil.utoronto.ca): Governance structure, agendas, policies, and official university decisions.
- [Policies](https://governingcouncil.utoronto.ca/secretariat/policies): Central repository of university governing policies and procedures.
- [Human Resources & Equity](https://people.utoronto.ca): HR services, benefits, workplace resources, and equity information.
- [Careers at U of T](https://jobs.utoronto.ca): Employment opportunities for faculty, staff, and student positions.
- [Accessibility Services & Information](https://people.utoronto.ca/inclusion/accessibility): Accessibility policies, supports, and workplace guidance.
- [Contact U of T](https://www.utoronto.ca/contacts): Directory and contact information for central university services.
